name: Lorong Chuan
summary: CCL residential belt between Serangoon and Bartley — condo-heavy pockets with NEX errands close enough to borrow without paying full interchange rents.
body: Lorong Chuan is the Circle Line shortlist for households who want Serangoon amenities within a short hop but prefer residential stacks over living above the bus interchange. Condo belts and selective HDB edges define the housing mix; weekend life still often routes through NEX. Expats land here for CCL commute math and a slightly quieter night profile than Serangoon Central, while accepting that big groceries and cinema nights lean on the hub. Compare with Bartley for a calmer CCL stop further from NEX, Kovan when NEL + hawker hub is the priority, and Serangoon when you want to be inside the interchange premium.
